Order privacy

The Merchandise and Retail Committee at IIM Trichy uses order details to reconcile UPI payments and fulfil merchandise orders.

Google sign-in

Google supplies a verified email address, account identifier and profile name. MARC uses these to associate each order with its buyer. A sign-in cookie lasts up to seven days.

What MARC records

Checkout records your name, email, phone number, affiliation, selected items and amount. Students in the listed PGPM cohorts also enter a roll number. When you submit payment proof, MARC receives the UPI reference and screenshot for manual review.

Who can see it

Buyers can view their own orders after signing in. The store sends your order to the committee’s restricted Google spreadsheet and saves the payment screenshot in its restricted Google Drive folder. This browser can keep a signed receipt that you can view after signing in again.

Questions about an order

Contact MARC through the committee channel that shared this store. Quote your order reference when requesting a correction or asking about your data.
